 Exes Pete Davidson and Elsie Hewitt team up for family Halloween costume with daughter Scottie 
 By 
 Antoinette Bueno 
 Published 
 Nov. 1, 2026, 3:57 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Pete Davidson and Elsie Hewitt joined forces on Halloween, sporting hilarious matching “Sopranos”-themed costumes with their daughter, Scottie.
 The model posted Instagram pics on Sunday of her dressed as the character Christopher Moltisanti, complete with a neck brace and tracksuit jacket.
 Davidson, meanwhile, channeled Paulie “Walnuts” Gualtieri by dying the sides of his hair gray and rocking a black leather jacket, sunglasses and black pants.
 Baby Scottie was, of course, main character Tony Soprano, sporting an adorable bathrobe, a mini gold watch and holding a fake cigar.

 Scottie rode in a Radio Flyer wagon, complete with ducks inside and a neon sign reading “Bada Bing!” — the fictional strip club in the HBO hit.
 Hewitt captioned the pics ““smells like halloween,” referencing Moltisanti’s memorable line in the show from Season 6.
 Hewitt, 30, and Davidson, 32, welcomed Scottie in December 2025.
 They split in May after more than a year together, with a source telling Page Six at the time, “There have been problems throughout their relationship and things are not good between them at all. They haven’t been for a while.”

 She later claimed she was raising Scottie solo, asking for help in a TikTok video.
 “I have a baby to take care of. I have to work and make money,” she said. “I’m doing it on my own, which is hard.”
 However, his pals claimed to Page Six that the former “Saturday Night Live” star was “paying for everything related to Elsie and Scottie,” including “the rent, their living expenses, their health insurance.”
 The source told us, “Obviously, they have had personal disagreements and there has been a breakdown in the relationship but he is fully committed to being a good dad.”
 6 
 Hewitt and Davidson (seen here in July 2025) split in May. elsie/Instagram 
 6 
 Hewitt later claimed she was raising Scottie alone, but the two have since reached a joint co-parenting agreement and are now on good terms. They’re seen here in December 2025. Instagram/@elsie 
 But the drama was resolved by July, when the two reached a joint co-parenting agreement two months after their breakup.
 “We are cooperatively co-parenting our daughter whose well-being remains our top priority, and we are fully committed to working together to give her love from both of us,” they shared in an exclusive statement to Page Six.
 In August, Hewitt thanked Davidson for Olivia Dean concert tickets, referring to him as her “baby daddy.”
